actions: OPEN INPUT PRES-IN ADJUST-IN OUTPUT PAYOUT-OUT NETWORK-OUT REPORT-OUT
PERFORM SETTLE-MERCHANT UNTIL WS-PRES-KEY = HIGH-VALUES AND WS-ADJUST-KEY = HIGH-VALUES
CLOSE PRES-IN ADJUST-IN PAYOUT-OUT NETWORK-OUT REPORT-OUT

rules.sentence: When `WS-OWING-COUNT` is more than zero, it opens `PRES-IN` and `ADJUST-IN` for input and `PAYOUT-OUT`, `NETWORK-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`; performs `READ-ADJUSTMENT`; performs `SETTLE-MERCHANT` until `WS-PRES-KEY` is high values and `WS-ADJUST-KEY` is high values; performs `WRITE-NETWORK-SETTLEMENT`; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `PRES-IN`, `ADJUST-IN`, `PAYOUT-OUT`, `NETWORK-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

When `WS-OWING-COUNT` is at most zero, it opens `PRES-IN` and `ADJUST-IN` for input and `PAYOUT-OUT`, `NETWORK-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`; performs `READ-ADJUSTMENT`; performs `SETTLE-MERCHANT` until `WS-PRES-KEY` is high values and `WS-ADJUST-KEY` is high values; performs `WRITE-NETWORK-SETTLEMENT`; performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `PRES-IN`, `ADJUST-IN`, `PAYOUT-OUT`, `NETWORK-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.
When reading `PRES-IN` finds no more records, it reads `PRES-IN` and sets `WS-PRES-KEY` to high values.
When reading `PRES-IN` finds a record, it reads `PRES-IN` and sets `WS-PRES-KEY` to `PS-MERCHANT`.
When reading `ADJUST-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ADJUST-IN` and sets `WS-ADJUST-KEY` to high values.
When reading `ADJUST-IN` finds a record, it reads `ADJUST-IN` and sets `WS-ADJUST-KEY` to `AD-MERCHANT`.

actions: MOVE ZERO TO WS-GROSS WS-INTERCHANGE WS-ADJUSTMENTS

rules.sentence: When `WS-PRES-KEY` is less than `WS-ADJUST-KEY` and `WS-MERCHANT-RANGE` is `'LCS'` (`WS-OUR-MERCHANT`), it sets `WS-MERCHANT` to `WS-PRES-KEY`; sets `WS-GROSS`, `WS-INTERCHANGE`, and `WS-ADJUSTMENTS` to zero; repeats its loop until `WS-PRES-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; repeats its loop until `WS-ADJUST-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; and performs `WRITE-PAYOUT`.

When `WS-PRES-KEY` is less than `WS-ADJUST-KEY` and `WS-MERCHANT-RANGE` is not `'LCS'` (not `WS-OUR-MERCHANT`), it sets `WS-MERCHANT` to `WS-PRES-KEY`; sets `WS-GROSS`, `WS-INTERCHANGE`, and `WS-ADJUSTMENTS` to zero; repeats its loop until `WS-PRES-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; repeats its loop until `WS-ADJUST-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; and performs `ADD-TO-NETWORK`.

When `WS-PRES-KEY` is at least `WS-ADJUST-KEY` and `WS-MERCHANT-RANGE` is `'LCS'` (`WS-OUR-MERCHANT`), it sets `WS-MERCHANT` to `WS-ADJUST-KEY`; sets `WS-GROSS`, `WS-INTERCHANGE`, and `WS-ADJUSTMENTS` to zero; repeats its loop until `WS-PRES-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; repeats its loop until `WS-ADJUST-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; and performs `WRITE-PAYOUT`.

When `WS-PRES-KEY` is at least `WS-ADJUST-KEY` and `WS-MERCHANT-RANGE` is not `'LCS'` (not `WS-OUR-MERCHANT`), it sets `WS-MERCHANT` to `WS-ADJUST-KEY`; sets `WS-GROSS`, `WS-INTERCHANGE`, and `WS-ADJUSTMENTS` to zero; repeats its loop until `WS-PRES-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; repeats its loop until `WS-ADJUST-KEY` is not `WS-MERCHANT`; and performs `ADD-TO-NETWORK`.
When `PS-MATCH` is `'M'` (`PS-MATCHED`), it adds `PS-AMOUNT` to `WS-GROSS`, adds `PS-FEE` to `WS-INTERCHANGE`, and performs `READ-PRESENTMENT`.

When `PA-NET` is less than zero, it sets `PA-MERCHANT` to `WS-MERCHANT`, sets `PA-GROSS` to `WS-GROSS`, sets `PA-INTERCHANGE` to `WS-INTERCHANGE`, sets `PA-ADJUSTMENTS` to `WS-ADJUSTMENTS`, computes `PA-NET` as `WS-GROSS - WS-INTERCHANGE + WS-ADJUSTMENTS`, sets `PA-STATUS` to `PA-OWES`, adds 1 to `WS-OWING-COUNT`, and writes `PAYOUT`.

When `PA-NET` is at least zero, it sets `PA-MERCHANT` to `WS-MERCHANT`, sets `PA-GROSS` to `WS-GROSS`, sets `PA-INTERCHANGE` to `WS-INTERCHANGE`, sets `PA-ADJUSTMENTS` to `WS-ADJUSTMENTS`, computes `PA-NET` as `WS-GROSS - WS-INTERCHANGE + WS-ADJUSTMENTS`, sets `PA-STATUS` to `PA-PAID`, adds 1 to `WS-PAID-COUNT`, adds `PA-NET` to `WS-PAID-TOTAL`, and writes `PAYOUT`.
